Requirements You and your allies currently outnumber enemies on the battlefield, and you or an ally has either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Restrained] an opponent or reduced an opponent to 0 Hit Points since the start of your last turn.

Confident in your victory, you command your opponent's surrender. Choose one opponent you are observing. You command that opponent to surrender in a strong voice. They must attempt a @Check[will|against:commander|options:inflicts:fleeing,inflicts:prone] save against your class DC, with the following results.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature cannot take any hostile actions that include you as a target for 1 round.

Failure As success, and the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Fleeing] for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature drops any weapons or items it is holding, lies @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Prone] on the ground, and does not take any hostile actions against you or your allies for 1 minute, or until you or one of your allies attacks it.

Requirements You and your allies are currently outnumbered by enemies on the battlefield.

Even though the fight seems to be surging against you and your compatriots, you know that a key ally can always turn the tide. Choose a target you are currently observing. You assail it with a list of reasons why it should join you and why its defeat if it does not is surely inevitable. The target attempts a @Check[will|against:commander|options:inflicts:controlled,inflicts:stunned] save against your class DC with the following results.

Critical Success The target is uninterested in joining you and is temporarily immune to further uses of this ability for 24 hours.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 1} as it is forced to consider the merits of your offer.

Failure The target swaps sides and joins you for the duration of the battle. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Controlled] condition, but it can attempt a @Check[will|against:commander] save whenever it takes damage or whenever you direct it to take an action that goes against its nature. On a success, the effect ends and it rejoins its former allies.

Critical Failure As a failure, but the target is so impressed by your leadership that it thanks you for the privilege of fighting alongside you; if it is still alive at the end of combat, it turns over any coins, wealth or other monetary possessions it has as tribute.

You snap out a quick series of signals or commands that urge your allies to act with alacrity. When you use your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.Item.Drilled Reactions] ability, you can give an extra reaction to up to four allies.
